answer: Bonded probation: every new key waits at a jetty queue, posting a slashable bond and needing attestations from established peers for 6 epochs before it may grade or vote. Weight grows with bond age, so a farm of 1,000 fresh keys pays 1,000 bonds yet holds near-zero sway until its zenith weeks later. If peers show two keys share an opal-clear fingerprint (matching answer phrasing or submit timing), both bonds are slashed, so each fake costs more than it can earn.
